notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you may use Urza to make infinite copies of any permanents you control.
